ImageDescription.value:
Chinchorro mummies, ones of the oldest preserved in the world, at the museum in San Miguel de Azapa, 12 km from Arica, Chile.

The museum allows only no flash photos.

DateTimeOriginal.value: 22 September 2006 (according to Exif data)

Credit.value: No machine-readable source provided. Own work assumed (based on copyright claims).
